site.title: Shop
site.description: A small demo storefront built with Alpine and Tailwind — no framework, no build step.
order.payment: Choose how you would like to pay.
order.noCard: Card payment is not available yet. Please choose cash on delivery.
order.empty: There is nothing in the cart.
order.twice: The same product is in this order twice.
order.oneGone: One of these products is no longer sold.
order.gone: {title} is no longer sold. Remove it from the cart to order the rest.
order.priceChanged: The price of {title} changed while it was in your cart.
order.atMost: One order can take at most {n} of {title}.
order.notEnough: {title} does not have that many left.
order.currencies: These products are not priced in the same currency.
order.shipping: Shipping costs more than the page showed. Reload the page to see the new total.
orders.onlyShop: Only the shop can change an order.
orders.status: That is not a status an order can have.
orders.reopen: Not enough {title} left to reopen this order.
chat.noVisitor: This browser has no visitor id. Reload the page and try again.
chat.pickOrWrite: Pick a question from the list or write one.
chat.tooLong: A question can be at most {n} characters.
chat.productGone: This product is no longer sold.
chat.faqGone: That question is no longer on the list.
chat.guestLimit: A guest can ask {n} questions. Create an account or sign in to keep asking.
inbox.onlyShopReply: Only the shop can reply here.
inbox.tooLong: A reply can be at most {n} characters.
inbox.onlyShopClose: Only the shop can close a conversation.
inbox.onlyShopDelete: Only the shop can delete a conversation.
inbox.onlyShopClear: Only the shop can clear the inbox.
inbox.reload: Reload the inbox and try again.
products.onlyShop: Only the shop can change its products.
products.name: Give the product a name.
products.category: Choose a category or type a new one.
products.regularPrice: Leave it empty, or make it higher than the price.
products.stock: Enter how many are in stock: 0 or more.
products.weight: Enter the packed weight in grams.
products.image: Paste the address of a picture, starting with https://.
products.images: Put one picture address on each line, each starting with https://.
products.stockChanged: The stock changed to {n} since you opened this product, most likely an order. Check the number and save again.
products.nameTaken: Too many products share this name. Change it a little.
mail.onlyShopSee: Only the shop can see its mails.
mail.onlyShopTest: Only the shop can send a test mail.
mail.cannotFill: The template could not be filled: {error}
mail.noSuchMail: There is no mail by that name.
mail.notSent: The mail could not be sent. Check Settings → Mail in the dashboard.
settings.onlyShop: Only the shop can change its settings.
settings.noSuchLanguage: The shop has no such language.
telegram.question: Question about {product}
